units.source_text: 临时雇佣的伙计用傲慢的口气指点着，并自嘲似地说：自己是到处奔波谋生计的。

en.t: The temporarily hired clerk pointed things out in an arrogant tone, then said with self-mockery that he made his living by wandering from place to place.

units.source_text: 有一种人从枫叶嫩绿时分到枫红季节这段时间来这里附近的山上温泉干活，

en.t: There were men who worked at mountain hot springs around here from the season when the maple leaves were tender green until they turned red,

units.source_text: 冬天则去热海、长冈等伊豆温泉浴场谋生。

en.t: and in winter went to earn their living at Izu hot spring resorts such as Atami and Nagaoka.

units.source_text: 他就是这种人当中的一个。

en.t: He was one of those men.

units.source_text: 每年不一定在同一客栈干活。

en.t: He did not necessarily work at the same inn every year.

units.source_text: 他好卖弄在伊豆繁华温泉浴场的经验，背地里尽唠叨这一带接待客人工作的短处。

en.t: He liked to show off his experience at the busy Izu hot spring resorts, and behind people's backs he did nothing but complain about the way guests were handled in this area.

units.source_text: 他那副搓着手死乞百赖拉客的样子，表露了毫无诚意的态度。

en.t: The way he rubbed his hands and persistently tried to pull in customers revealed an attitude with no sincerity at all.

units.source_text: “先生，您见过通草果吧，想吃的话，我给您拿去。”

en.t: Sir, you have seen akebi fruit, haven't you? If you would like to eat some, I will bring it to you.

units.source_text: 他对散步回来的岛村说了这么一句，然后把通草果连同蔓藤系在挂满红叶的枫枝上。

en.t: He said this to Shimamura when he came back from his walk, and then tied the akebi fruit, vine and all, to a maple branch covered with red leaves.

units.source_text: 枫枝大概是从山上采来的，足有屋檐高，

en.t: The maple branch seemed to have been cut from the mountain and was as high as the eaves,

units.source_text: 那鲜艳的颜色，顿时把大门口装饰得明亮起来，

en.t: and its vivid color instantly brightened the entrance,
and each red leaf was astonishingly large.
